§ 05 — Design Process
How I approach the work

A repeatable process, not a formula.

01

Research

Talk to users, study the market, frame the problem before reaching for solutions.

02

Strategy

Define goals, scope, and what success actually looks like for the project.

03

Wireframe

Sketch flows, structure information, test the logic before any pixels.

04

Design

Build the visual layer — type, color, hierarchy, the polish that makes it feel right.

05

Prototype

Stitch it together. Make it click, swipe, breathe — closer to the real thing.

06

Iterate

Test, learn, refine. Ship is the start, not the finish line.
